description: Election administration context registry for equipment, audit, CVR, and incident source packages. Equipment rows are contextual metadata and are not mixed into vote or turnout calculations.

equipment.caveat: Verified Voting Verifier data is county-level election-administration context. It documents equipment systems and related fields by jurisdiction; it is not a turnout or vote-result source.

audit.why: Wisconsin post-election audit or canvass/recount artifacts have not been normalized into this administration context registry yet.

cvr.why: County CVR availability has not been inventoried or normalized for Wisconsin 2024 yet.

incidents.why: Incident, correction, and litigation notes have not been collected into a normalized source package yet.
